# Latest Stable Version of LangGraph on PyPI (May 2026)

## Overview

Based on available source information, the latest stable version of LangGraph published on PyPI as of May 2026 is **version 1.2.1**.

## Version Details

The core `langgraph` package reached version 1.2.1 as the most recent stable release [3]. This release included several notable changes: bug fixes to keep tool results out of v3 messages, new opt-in functionality for stream transformers via `before_builtins`, and general dependency updates [3].

## Accompanying Package Versions

LangGraph's ecosystem consists of several interdependent packages, all of which have corresponding stable releases alongside the core library. As of the same timeframe, the following companion packages were published on PyPI [3]:

- **langgraph-sdk** == 0.3.15
- **langgraph-checkpoint** == 4.1.1
- **langgraph-prebuilt** == 1.1.0
- **langgraph-cli** == 0.4.26
- **langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite** == 3.1.0
- **langgraph-checkpoint-postgres** == 3.1.0

## Recent Development Focus

Leading up to version 1.2.1, the LangGraph team concentrated on reliability and expanded functionality. Key improvements included durable error-handler resume across host crashes, the introduction of `set_node_defaults()` for `StateGraph`, delta channel snapshot enhancements, and streaming walk overrides for checkpoint history retrieval [3].

## Caveats

It is worth noting that the PyPI project page for `langgraph` [1] and the `langgraph-api` page [2] did not return accessible content, so the version confirmation relies primarily on the GitHub releases page [3]. Users should verify the current stable release directly on [pypi.org/project/langgraph](https://pypi.org/project/langgraph) to confirm no newer release has been published since this reporting period.
